parameters.content:
# Monitoring
Sabine hears about problems from Avanai, not from a supplier.
**When a workflow fails** (every workflow names this as its error workflow) and **every 15 minutes** (re-run emails stored but never finished; alert when queues age or the mailbox goes quiet). One alert per problem, repeats are counted; on-call gets an e-mail with where to look, never email content.

parameters.query: with ex as (update alerts set occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_seen = now() where id = (select id from alerts where source = $1 and message = $2 and not acknowledged and ts > now() - interval '24 hours' order by ts desc limit 1) returning id), ins as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select 'critical', $1, $2, $3::jsonb where not exists (select 1 from ex) returning id) select (select id from ins) is not null as is_new, 'critical' as severity, $1 as source, $2 as message

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ 'workflow:' + ($json.workflow && $json.workflow.name || 'unknown'), String(($json.execution && $json.execution.error && $json.execution.error.message) || ($json.trigger && $json.trigger.error && $json.trigger.error.message) || 'Workflow failed').slice(0, 300), JSON.stringify({ execution_id: $json.execution && $json.execution.id, url: $json.execution && $json.execution.url, last_node: $json.execution && $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted }) ] }}

parameters.query: select e.message_id, e.from_addr, e.subject, e.body, e.received_at, e.attachments, e.meta from inbound_emails e where not exists (select 1 from documents d where d.message_id = e.message_id) and e.created_at < now() - interval '10 minutes' order by e.created_at limit 20

select * from (select 'warning' as severity, 'ERP bookings waiting more than 2 hours' as message, count(*) as n from documents where status = 'pending_erp' and updated_at < now() - interval '2 hours' having count(*) > 0 union all select 'warning', 'Invoices waiting for review more than 2 working days', count(*) from documents where status = 'needs_review' and created_at < now() - interval '2 days' having count(*) > 0 union all select 'critical', 'Emails received but not processed after 30 minutes', count(*) from inbound_emails e where not exists (select 1 from documents d where d.message_id = e.message_id) and e.created_at < now() - interval '30 minutes' having count(*) > 0 union all select 'warning', 'No email received for 4 hours during business hours (mailbox connection?)', 0 from (select max(created_at) as m from inbound_emails) x where extract(isodow from now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') < 6 and extract(hour from now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') between 9 and 17 and (x.m is null or x.m < now() - interval '4 hours')) f

with ex as (update alerts set occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_seen = now() where id = (select id from alerts where source = 'watchdog' and message = $2 and not acknowledged and ts > now() - interval '24 hours' order by ts desc limit 1) returning id), ins as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select $1, 'watchdog', $2, jsonb_build_object('count', $3)::jsonb where not exists (select 1 from ex) returning id) select (select id from ins) is not null as is_new, $1 as severity, 'watchdog' as source, $2 as message

parameters.subject: =[Hallmann intake · {{ $json.severity }}] {{ $json.message }}
